summary: Validated the fix for the reported bug 'no aparece en traslados' (missing Change button on Premium Transfer card at Trip Planner Step 3). Ran full frontend Playwright coverage on mobile (390px) and desktop (1440px). The swap-transfer button is now present, visible, styled correctly (stone-800 bg + white text + RefreshCw icon + 'Change' label), and cycles the vehicle type Mercedes S-Class -> Luxury Minibus -> Premium Coach -> Mercedes S-Class as expected. Regression: swap-hotel, swap-restaurant, swap-beach-club continue to work. End-to-end submission verified — backend POST /api/trip-planner payload includes transfer_type='minibus' after one swap click, and the SuccessView is displayed.
critical_code_review_comments: TripPlanner.jsx is now ~828 lines; consider extracting Step components (StepServices, StepDateTime, StepItinerary, StepContact, SuccessView) into separate files to stay under the 700-line guideline.
Duplicate ternary for transfer label/desc rendering (lines ~753-757) could be simplified using a memoized const (e.g. const activeTransfer = TRANSFER_TYPES.find(...) || TRANSFER_TYPES[0]).
Two harmless 401 errors observed in console on initial page load (unrelated to Trip Planner) — recommend investigating the failing resource to keep the console clean.
seed_data_creation: None. A single TEST_ trip-planner request was submitted end-to-end with email test_transfer@example.com to verify transfer_type persistence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Change/swap button on the Premium Transfer card (data-testid=swap-transfer) is fully working and integrated. Vehicle rotation order: sedan -> minibus -> coach -> sedan. Backend receives transfer_type in POST /api/trip-planner correctly. Note: service testid uses underscore (service-beach_club) while swap testid uses hyphen (swap-beach-club) — mixing conventions in TripPlanner.jsx.
rca of the issue: Root cause: the ItineraryCard sub-component (used for Hotel/Restaurant/Beach Club) already contained the RefreshCw Change button, but the Transfer card was rendered as an inline div in StepItinerary without that button. Fix applied by main agent: added swapTransfer() function that cycles TRANSFER_TYPES by index, passed the prop to StepItinerary, and appended an identically-styled Change button (data-testid=swap-transfer) inside the Transfer card. Verified visually and functionally on mobile+desktop.
